summary: Startup no longer prints ERROR and WARNING lines about the Triton MoE kernels and the optional DeepSelect extension
compatibility: No user action required. The messages still appear with VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG.
details: The import-time probes for triton_kernels.matmul_ogs (fused MoE config and the MXFP4 oracle) and for vllm._deepselect_C now log at DEBUG. The image's triton_kernels is newer than the matmul_ogs API, and DeepSelect is opt-in and needs SM100a/SM103a, so these lines appeared on every start without affecting any shipped model.
